authority: Maintainer accepted the proposed adaptive-filter sham-input test: lets do it keep going and finding ways to get better results; approved charter Tier B
target: Five-word calibration label; all600 development trials from six recordings, three people and both conditions; no exclusions
hypothesis: The EOG/lip-fed adaptive filter can produce word-predictive features with no recorded EEG-channel samples entering those features; per-trial normalization is a separate competing explanation for prior improvement
preprocessing: Unchanged source EEG gain, notch50/100, CAR and all-channel2-118Hz filtering on1626samples. Trial normalization uses float64 mean and std(ddof1)+machineepsilon over all1626samples perchannel. NLMS uses original adaptive_residual with per-trial normalization, mu.1, eps.001, fixed random weights seed20260906, reset eachtrial. All views crop25:1625 thenfloat32 before identical float64 spectral features.

sham.construction: np.random.default_rng(20260922).normal(0,1,(128,1626)); pass through source_filter with zero(5,1626) auxiliaries once per recording. Identical template for every trial and recording, independent of recorded EEG, labels, trial index, timing, person and condition.
sham.allowed_varying_input: Only the original conventionally filtered EOG and two lip waveforms enter sham_filtered_repetition via the unchanged adaptive_residual. No recorded EEG amplitude, variance, normalization denominator, fitted transform or spectrum enters either sham branch.
sham.limit: One fixed nondegenerate template, not spectrum-matched to recorded EEG. No later seed, amplitude or template search. Sham-negative is inconclusive about EEG origin; auxiliary electrodes may themselves contain mixed physiological sources.

representations.raw_repetition: Conventionally preprocessed recorded EEG, without per-trial normalization or NLMS
representations.normalized_repetition: Same recorded EEG with per-trial normalization only, no NLMS
representations.filtered_repetition: Same recorded EEG through unchanged auxiliary-fed adaptive_residual
representations.sham_normalized_repetition: Fixed source-filtered sham with per-trial normalization only; identical features every trial
representations.sham_filtered_repetition: Fixed source-filtered sham through unchanged adaptive_residual with real EOG/lips; no recorded EEG-channel samples

features: Same768features perview:128channels times6bands2-4,4-8,8-13,13-30,30-60,60-118Hz. Five320sample repetitions at256Hz; one-sided squared FFT/320^2, no taper, upperedge118included, average per-repetition powers thenlog. N is unchanged392auxiliary/timingfeatures.
arms: 29total: N,N_shuffled,uniform,training_prior; for each five views R: R,R_shuffled,N_R,N_R_deranged,N_R_shuffled. Every arm retained under both schemes.
model: Unchanged fixed one-hot ridge alpha1 with unpenalized intercept and softmax. Train-only perfeature centering/scaling; auxiliary and EEG/sham blocks each divided bysqrt(own dimension). No tuning or probability calibration.
split_algorithms: Same blocked_embargo1 primary: five chronological20trialblocks, one adjacent traintrial embargo perboundary,78/79traintrials; same stratified_shuffled secondary: StratifiedKFold5 shuffleTrue random_state20260921,80traintrials. Retrospective within-recording, not past-to-future. Original trial with all five repetitions is indivisible. All six class-support and split-hash preflights before any fit.
label_shuffle: Training labels only; seed20260921+100*scheme_index+fold_index, same permutation across arms; validation targets unchanged
derangement: EEG/sham feature rows roll one position separately within train and validation; N stays aligned. Original training rows determine scaling. No crossfold donors. Single misalignment diagnostic, not permutation inference.
primary_metric: Class-macro log loss over100pooled out-of-fold trials per person; equal-person descriptive means; balanced accuracy secondary
primary_threshold: Strictly lower log loss than allfour comparators in every one of three people within a condition under blockedvalidation. Report minimallyovert and covert separately. Descriptive consistency, not statistical significance.
secondary_threshold: Strictly lower log loss than allseven comparators in allthreepeople percondition; descriptive secondary diagnostic, not fresh confirmation

interpretation.sham_pass: Demonstrates an auxiliary-to-processed-feature predictive pathway without recorded EEG-channel inputs on these calibration recordings. Does not establish that all real-EEG performance is peripheral, that auxiliaries have no neural contribution, or that NLMS generally fails.
interpretation.normalization_matches_or_beats_adaptive: No demonstrated adaptive-filter-specific advantage over per-trial normalization for this readout
interpretation.real_joint_secondary_pass: Residual recorded-EEG contribution beyond these specific normalization/sham/nuisance comparators remains plausible; cortical origin and independent neural communication unresolved
interpretation.subset_people: Heterogeneous result, all-person threshold fails; retain individual outcomes
interpretation.sham_fail: This single fixed template did not demonstrate the pathway; not proof of neural origin or absence of other peripheral transformations
interpretation.random_only: Sensitive to temporal split structure, not consistent held-out-block prediction

stop_rule: One invocation after generated checks and both remote CI jobs pass. Preserve failure, no automatic retry or partial aggregate. No code changes during execution. Stream trials; no retained waveform or feature cache. All three previous result aggregates remain byte-identical.
forbidden: old private targets, predictions or weights
